criteria.name: Core Web Vitals meet defined targets
evidence: GitHub Actions Quality Gates run 35257412723 passed the strict Lighthouse CI and frontend performance-budget gates on the production build.
The Lighthouse gate requires 100/100 Performance for every desktop and mobile sample on the homepage, courses, and contact routes.

criteria.name: WCAG 2.2 AA checks pass
evidence: Pa11y and Lighthouse accessibility gates are configured; WCAG 2.2 manual review remains.

criteria.name: Full mobile journey works
evidence: GitHub Actions Quality Gates run 35257412723 passed Responsive browser E2E.

The suite exercises navigation, contact form, synthetic student dashboard, invoice table, checkout/payment state, and lesson interface across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit at mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports (54 checks).

criteria.name: Student resumes the last lesson
evidence: GitHub Actions Quality Gates and Release run 35354817117 deployed exact main SHA 0345bfe99ce1f5a06068842c7c7c45fe6ea624a4 to Render staging.

The staging acceptance step persisted synthetic student progress at lesson acceptance-algebra, position 347 seconds and 42%, then fetched the resume and protected lesson endpoints and verified the same persisted state.

criteria.name: Slow and interrupted connections recover gracefully
evidence: Branded connection recovery and safe form drafts are implemented; mobile network testing remains.

criteria.name: Course search returns useful results
evidence: Topic, title, curriculum and level filtering is implemented; representative search relevance sign-off remains.

criteria.name: Checkout communicates every state
evidence: Pending, cancelled and failed payment pages are implemented; paid and delayed confirmation journey requires staging proof.

criteria.name: Delayed PayFast ITN is handled correctly
evidence: Payment Security run 35339900771 passed the deterministic PayFast security suite.

The suite proves a delayed verified callback within the configured replay window is accepted and fulfilled exactly once, while an expired callback is rejected before any gateway verification call; no real PayFast charge or live provider request is used.

criteria.name: Students cannot access another student's data
evidence: Live Supabase project epkcuseloinygkakxxdu has RLS enabled on public.student_profiles with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE ownership predicates based on auth.uid() = id.
A live authenticated cross-user test using a different synthetic UUID returned visible_other_profiles=0.

criteria.name: Protected content is never publicly cached
evidence: GitHub Actions Quality Gates and Release run 35344274130 passed the production worker protected-response cache-header test on release commit 179691dea3f6626d3f83f066991149e8e8c08a43.
The test verifies protected /checkout responses are private, no-store, max-age=0 with Vary: Cookie and confirms protected prefixes for dashboard, documents, checkout and auth-state handling.

criteria.name: Automated backups restore successfully
evidence: Backup Restore Verification run 35257412727 passed end-to-end using PostgreSQL 17, the exact recovery image, deterministic synthetic data, encrypted Restic backup, isolated restore, and integrity verification.

criteria.name: Load tests meet agreed thresholds
evidence: Normal, peak, spike and degraded Locust gates are implemented; staging results remain.
